title: The Dow Market Happenings For Monday, December 24, 2018
text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Monday, December 24, 2018 Posted by admin on December 24th, 2018
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. Dow stock 52 week lows include Apple (AAPL), Chevron (CVX), Goldman Sachs (GS), Home Depot (HD), IBM (IBM), JPMorgan (JPM), Travelers (TRV), United Technologies and Exxon Mobil (XOM). That’s nine (9) Dow stocks with new lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -85 points.
Friday the Dow was down -414.23 (-1.81%) at 22,445.37.
Year-to-date the Dow is down -9.2%.
There were 3 Dow stocks up Friday.
The Dow stock winners Friday were Nike (NKE) +7.17%%, McDonald’s (MCD) +0.27% and Coca Cola (KO) +0.06%.
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by Goldman Sachs (GS) -4.96%, American Express (AXP) -4.64% and Apple (AAPL) -3.89%.
European stocks are mostly lower and Asian markets ended mostly lower.
The national average price of gasoline is down six-tenths of a cent at $2.322 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
There are no Dow stocks set to release earnings in the near term.
Today’s Featured Dow Stock
Exxon Mobil (XOM)
Exxon Mobil (XOM) is down -18.56% year-to-date.
